svg.title: How the Weighted Contributions Sum to b(0.5)
svg.desc: One waterfall plot explains b(0.5) at each training step. The first 16 floating bars add the actual weighted hidden features, the next bar adds the output bias, and the last bar shows the resulting total from zero. Identity passes each hidden feature unchanged before weighting. All 16 contributions and the bias come from the same recorded ResNet checkpoint as the main animation. The input X=0.5 and the axis range stay fixed. Bar endpoints interpolate between checkpoints; numerical readouts show rounded checkpoint values.
